Class OAuthValidateRateLimiter

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.oauth.OAuthValidateRateLimiter
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class OAuthValidateRateLimiter extends Object
Bounds the anonymous validation of authorization requests to 30 per client address within an hour. The address is resolved the way the login lockout resolves it, so a trusted proxy's forwarding header names the client and an untrusted one is ignored. The window of an address starts with its first request and is fixed: further requests do not prolong it.
